question: Which revision of Pollen's RPI Robot HAT is the board in our CAD?
answer: A PRE-RELEASE DEVELOPMENT REVISION THAT WAS NEVER PRODUCED — the layout as it stood at commit fbd885d, immediately before commit 96ffef3 whose message reads verbatim 'Just figure out the 40-pin GPIO conn. is inverted :-/' and 96a1b9a '[update] Positionning after flipping.' Every board Pollen has had made (A1 = c5f5583, 15 pcs; B1 = 4549a3e, 125 pcs; C1 = 13dba37/23eab11, 20 pcs) carries the OTHER layout.
verdict: FAIL — our CAD's Robot HAT is not the board in the robot.
how_it_was_settled: Pollen's simulation mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/elec_rpi_robot_hat_pcb.stl was measured directly (pure-python STL read, bottom-face vertex ring clustering, 18856 triangles): outline bbox -3.520 .. 61.505 x -26.510 .. 3.515 x 0 .. 0.840 mm; fourteen 0.950 mm holes at x = 43.850 / 48.650 (four rows y -23.000, -20.500, -18.000, -15.500) and x = 53.500 / 58.300 (three rows y -17.450, -14.950, -12.450); one 1.000 mm hole at (31.200, -11.900); forty 1.020 mm holes on 2.540 pitch at y +/-1.270.
The same features were read out of four revisions of the official elec_RPI_Robot_HAT.kicad_pcb (git history fetched 2026-09-04).

fbd885d ('BU before changing the 40-pin GPIO'): outline -3.520 .. 61.505 x -26.510 .. 3.515 (65.025 x 30.025); 0.95 holes at x 43.850 / 48.650 (4-pin J3/J11) and 53.500 / 58.300 (3-pin J13/J14). IDENTICAL TO THE MESH to 0.001 mm on every one of those 18 numbers.

The 4 x 2.700 mounting holes (0,0)(58,0)(0,-23)(58,-23), the 2 x 2.000 anchors (6.140,0)(51.860,0) and the 40 x 1.020 header holes are symmetric about the board's x centre and are IDENTICAL in every revision — which is why nothing in this repo caught it until the connector holes were compared.
what_this_breaks: CABLE ROUTING. On the released board the Dynamixel 3-pin connectors (J13/J14 — the ones the XL330 bus actually plugs into) sit at the -x end, next to the Stemma ports; in our CAD they are at the +x end. Every harness length and every route that leaves the HAT in wiring/cables.json is mirrored end-for-end.

BOARD OUTLINE. Our part builds 65.025 x 30.025 (hole-centred rounded rectangle, R3.52). The released board is 65.000 x 30.900: the corner arcs are R3.500 centred on (0, +0.900), (58, +0.900), (0, -23.000), (58, -23.000), so the +Y edge stands 4.400 mm above the mount row, not 3.500. Clearance to the head shell on that edge is 0.885 mm smaller than our model says.

DRILL. The mesh's single 1.000 mm hole at (31.200, -11.900) does not exist on any released board; the released boards carry three 1.000 mm test-point holes at (29.700, -15.825), (33.300, -15.825) and (58.600, -18.600).

THICKNESS. Both the mesh and the STEP body are 0.840 mm because that is the substrate (0.770 dielectric + 2 x 0.035 inner copper). The finished 4-layer board is 1.000 mm (kicad_pcb '(thickness 1)', stackup sums exactly).
